summary: Nixxy, Inc. filed an 8-K on July 2, 2026, reporting the resignation of CEO and director Mike Schmidt effective immediately, with no disagreement cited. The Board appointed director David Kratochvil, age 60, as CEO. Kratochvil brings over 30 years of Wall Street experience including venture capital, investment banking, and CFO roles at public companies. The transition appears orderly, with Kratochvil continuing as a director. No compensatory arrangements were disclosed. This is a forced/abrupt departure event, not routine succession planning. What to watch: whether Kratochvil's appointment signals a strategic shift in capital allocation or M&A direction.
